title: Injuring or defiling place of worship with intent to insult the religion of any class
old_text: Destroying, damaging or defiling any place of worship or sacred object with intent to insult religion.
new_text: Destroying, damaging or defiling any place of worship or sacred object with intent or knowledge that it insults religion.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 298 replaces IPC Section 295 protecting sacred places and religious shrines from defilement and desecration. It penalizes physical destruction or defiling of religious sites committed with intent to insult any religious denomination.

title: Deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs
old_text: Deliberate and malicious acts intending to outrage religious feelings of any class of citizens by words, signs or visible representations.
new_text: Deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings of any class of citizens by insulting religion or beliefs.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 299 replaces IPC Section 295A penalizing deliberate speech, publications, or representations made with malicious intention to outrage religious feelings. This provision continues to require proof of calculated malice rather than casual criticism.

title: Disturbing religious assembly
old_text: Voluntarily causing disturbance to any assembly lawfully engaged in religious worship or ceremonies.
new_text: Voluntarily causing disturbance to any assembly lawfully engaged in the performance of religious worship or ceremonies.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 300 replaces IPC Section 296 protecting congregation peace during lawful religious rites and gatherings. Disrupting legitimate prayer services or religious ceremonies carries imprisonment up to 1 year or fine.

title: Trespassing on burial places, etc.
old_text: Trespassing on burial places, places of sepulture, or places set apart for funeral rites with intent to wound feelings.
new_text: Trespassing on burial grounds, crematoriums, places of sepulture or funeral rites with intent to wound feelings or insult religion.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 301 replaces IPC Section 297 penalizing unauthorized intrusions or desecrations in cemeteries, burial plots, and cremation grounds. It also punishes causing indignity to any human corpse.

title: Uttering words, etc., with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings of any person
old_text: Uttering any word, making any sound or gesture in the hearing or sight of any person with deliberate intention of wounding religious feelings.
new_text: Uttering any word, making sound, gesture or placing any object with deliberate intent of wounding religious feelings of any person.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 302 replaces IPC Section 298 targeting interpersonal oral insults or provocative gestures aimed at wounding an individual's religious sentiments. It is a critical section number change since '302' in IPC was famously the section for murder punishment.
